name: 39577 · Wiggins, MS
findings: ZIP 39577 (Wiggins) has 24 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 39577 (Wiggins) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 39577 (Wiggins) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 50% of all organizations here have no identified type.
